label: Figure 15.6: Keynesian AS curve (three phases)
alt: A Keynesian aggregate supply curve that is horizontal at low output (1), curves upward (2), then becomes vertical at full-employment output Yf (3).
caption: The Keynesian AS curve has three phases. (1) At low output there is spare capacity, so AS is horizontal (perfectly elastic). (2) As the economy nears full employment factors become scarce and AS slopes upward. (3) At Y<sub>f</sub> no more can be produced, so AS is vertical (perfectly inelastic); this vertical section is the new classical LRAS.
